answer: A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each willow escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the lantern ledger records every share and the crystal audit shows the split. Assembling that for 175 aliases means 175 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
